summary: The recorded base reproduces the unified deterministic extend attention xAI-temperature mismatch. The exact candidate changes the affected Triton kernel to the logarithmic strict-greater-than rule used by regular extend and decode attention, and passes its regression plus independent GPU boundary references on gfx950.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate's exact regression against the prepared base; reproduced per-position differences up to 0.9590050578117371.
Candidate regression validating below-threshold, threshold, and above-threshold output against a logarithmically scaled numerical reference.
Independent fixed-seed GPU references for thresholds 2, 3, 4, and 8; head dimensions 32 and 64; positions below, equal to, and above the boundary. Maximum discrepancy was 5.364418029785156e-07.
Issue-specific unified versus regular Triton kernel parity on gfx950.
Full candidate parity matrix: issue-specific xAI case passed; unrelated temperature-disabled D=80 stochastic subcase failed the existing AMD tolerance with max diff 0.1669921875.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950, reported capability 9.5) executed the base and candidate Triton kernels under ROCm 7.2.

remaining_limitations: CUDA-specific execution was not available; the candidate was GPU-verified on ROCm gfx950.
No Grok weights or full serving/model-semantic validation were available.
The full parity matrix retains an unrelated stochastic temperature-disabled D=80 gfx950 tolerance failure.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes only Python Triton JIT source and Python tests.
